zh: 更新检测改用小黑DESK 自己的版本线：只比较自己的 GitHub Release，不再把上游 Aerial 的新版本误报为可升级版本，也不会下载官方安装包。
控制中心「更新」页常驻显示各版本新特性，中英文随系统语言切换，离线也能查看。
有新版本时从自己的 Release 下载安装；二维码直达小黑DESK 版本下载页。
更新提示、下载失败提示与文案全部改为自有版本说明。
en: Update checks now follow the xiaoheiDESK version line: only our own GitHub releases are compared, so an upstream Aerial release is never offered or downloaded.
The Control Center update page always lists what each version brings, in Chinese or English, even offline.
New releases are downloaded from our own release assets; the QR code opens our release page.
Update and download-failure messages now describe our own release channel.

zh: 正式版首发，App 与仓库可见名统一为「小黑DESK / xiaoheiDESK」。
全新图标：黑玻底 + 两只白色三角猫耳 + 一条卷尾，同步替换桌面图标、adaptive icon 与 TV 横幅。
桌面日期 / 天气 / 设置获得焦点时改为白字 + Quiet Glass 玻璃高光；选中 App 时仅在名称文字下显示玻璃胶囊，图标保持原样。
日历 / 天气 / 设置三个面板统一为与桌面焦点同款的玻璃材质。
农历日历：初一显示农历月名，节日标注优先（含清明），农历与公历节日同屏。
天气面板：城市设为杭州，支持雨量、12 小时预报；小时图标等宽，与未来一周左右对齐。
HOME 键双向切换自定义桌面与系统桌面，带防抖与前台守护。
苹果航拍屏保、照片库、控制中心、诊断导出等完整功能保留。
en: First official release, branded 小黑DESK / xiaoheiDESK throughout.
New icon: dark glass with two small white cat ears and a curled tail, applied to the launcher icon, adaptive icon and TV banner.
Focus styling: white text on glass for date, weather and settings; a glass capsule under an app's name only, with the icon untouched.
Calendar, weather and settings panels share the same glass finish as the home focus.
Lunar calendar: month name on the first day, festival labels take priority (including Qingming), lunar and solar holidays together.
Weather panel: Hangzhou, rainfall, 12-hour forecast, evenly spaced hour icons aligned with the weekly rows.
HOME toggles between this desk and the stock launcher in both directions, with debounce and a foreground guard.
Apple aerial screensavers, photo library, Control Center and diagnostics export all kept.
